src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
s: The ignition temperatures of four substances P, Q, R and S are 95°C, 98°C, 105°C and 108°C, respectively. Which substance/s will catch fire when they are exposed to a temperature of 100°C?
Which of the following is NOT correct about wage funding under MGNREGA and VB-G RAM G?
o: Under MGNREGA, the Centre bears 100% of the wage funding.
For North-Eastern and Himalayan States, the VB-G RAM G ratio is 90:10.
Under VB-G RAM G, the general Centre–State ratio is 50:50.
VB-G RAM G guarantees 125 days of employment.
x: VB-G RAM G's general Centre–State ratio is 60:40, not 50:50; the other statements are correct.

s: How many days of guaranteed employment does VB-G RAM G provide?
x: VB-G RAM G provides 125 guaranteed days of employment.

s: With which initiative are Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans under VB-G RAM G integrated?
x: Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans cover water security, rural and livelihood infrastructure and extreme-weather mitigation, and are integrated with PM Gati Shakti.

s: Who is eligible for employment under MGNREGA?
o: Only elderly persons in rural households
Adult members of any rural household
Only transgender persons in rural households
x: MGNREGA eligibility extends to adult members of any rural household. The other groups receive special attention under separate card provisions but are not the complete eligibility category.

s: Under VB-G RAM G, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Validity of Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards – 60 days
x: The Section 27 penalty is ₹10,000. Cards are valid for 3 years, guaranteed employment is 125 days and the agriculture pause is 60 days.

s: Which body reported nominal rural wage growth of only 3.6–6.4% a year during 2015–25?
x: The 3.6–6.4% annual nominal rural wage growth figure came from the Labour Bureau, not the World Bank.

s: Which Section of the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 provides 125 days of guaranteed employment?
x: The 125-day guarantee is in Section 5(1); Section 27 carries the ₹10,000 penalty.

s: For how long are the Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards under VB-G RAM G, which replace MGNREGA job cards, valid?
x: VB-G RAM G cards are valid for 3 years, against 5 years for MGNREGA job cards.

s: What is the central cost of the VB-G RAM G scheme?
x: The central cost is ₹95,692 crore; the total cost is ₹1.51 lakh crore, with about ₹30,000 crore a year falling on States.

s:
Consider the following statements about VB-G RAM G:
1. It provides a 60-day pause in peak sowing and harvest seasons.
2. Its allocation is a bottom-up labour budget prepared by Gram Panchayats.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: VB-G RAM G allocation is normative, set by the Centre; the bottom-up labour budget was MGNREGA's.

s: What is the penalty under Section 27 of the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025?
x: Section 27 raised the penalty from ₹1,000 under MGNREGA to ₹10,000.

s: On which date did Parliament pass the VB-G RAM G Bill?
x: Parliament passed it on 19 December 2025; it was notified in the gazette on 21 December 2025.

s: DAY-NRLM is a centrally sponsored scheme under which Ministry?
x: DAY-NRLM is a centrally sponsored scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development.

s: Jeevika, an institutional model linked to DAY-NRLM, is associated with which State?
x: Jeevika is Bihar's model; Kudumbashree is associated with Kerala.

s: Maiya Samman Yojana, a women-oriented DBT scheme, belongs to which State?
x: Maiya Samman Yojana is Jharkhand's scheme; Ladli Laxmi is of Madhya Pradesh, Ladki Bahin of Maharashtra and Mukhyamantri Mahila Rozgar of Bihar.

s: Which scheme was restructured to launch the National Rural Livelihoods Mission in 2010?
x: NRLM was launched in 2010 by restructuring SGSY and was renamed DAY-NRLM in 2016.

s: How many Self-Help Groups are covered under DAY-NRLM?
x: DAY-NRLM covers 91 lakh SHGs and 10 crore+ households; 5.35 lakh are Village Organisations.

s: Which State runs the Ladli Laxmi Yojana, a State DBT scheme for women?
x: Ladli Laxmi Yojana is Madhya Pradesh's scheme; Ladki Bahin is Maharashtra's and Maiya Samman Jharkhand's.

s: In which year was the National Rural Livelihoods Mission renamed DAY-NRLM?
x: NRLM was launched in 2010 by restructuring SGSY and renamed DAY-NRLM in 2016.

s:
Match the following State DBT schemes for women with their States:
List-I
A. Ladki Bahin Yojana
B. Maiya Samman Yojana
C. Ladli Laxmi Yojana
D. Mukhyamantri Mahila Rozgar Yojana
List-II
1. Bihar
2. Madhya Pradesh
3. Jharkhand
4. Maharashtra
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
x: Ladki Bahin - Maharashtra; Maiya Samman - Jharkhand; Ladli Laxmi - Madhya Pradesh; Mahila Rozgar - Bihar.

s: Kudumbashree, a model for DAY-NRLM, belongs to which State?
x: Kudumbashree is Kerala's model; Jeevika is Bihar's.

s: Each year, more than how many newborns in India die from resistant sepsis?
x: More than 50,000 newborns die every year in India from antibiotic-resistant sepsis.

s: Which pair of initiatives is associated with Kerala's response to antimicrobial resistance?
x: PROUD and AMRITH are Kerala's AMR initiatives; Schedule H1 and the Red Line Campaign are national AMR measures.

s: What is the rank of cervical cancer among the most common cancers in Indian women?
x: Cervical cancer is the second most common cancer among Indian women, with about 80,000 cases and over 42,000 deaths a year.

s: Under the free nationwide HPV vaccination programme, which ministry provides the vaccine to girls aged 14?
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
x: The Union Health Ministry provides voluntary and free HPV vaccination to girls aged 14.

s: On which platform is vaccination under the free nationwide HPV vaccination programme tracked?
x: HPV vaccination is given at government facilities and tracked on U-WIN.

s: Through which body was the vaccine for India's nationwide HPV vaccination programme procured?
x: The HPV vaccine for the programme was procured through Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance.

s: Which plan was launched for 2025–29 as the national action framework on antimicrobial resistance?
x: NAP-AMR 2.0 was launched for 2025–29, following NAP-AMR 1.0 of 2017. The Delhi Declaration was a 2017 inter-ministerial commitment, and the Chennai Declaration was a consensus of medical societies on rational antibiotic use.

s: Under NAP-AMR 2.0, which body provides inter-sectoral supervision through a Coordination & Monitoring Committee?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
x: NAP-AMR 2.0 places inter-sectoral supervision under NITI Aayog through a Coordination & Monitoring Committee.

s: NAP-AMR 2.0 treats human, animal and environmental health as interlinked. What is this approach called?
x: NAP-AMR 2.0 follows the One Health approach, which recognises that human, animal and environmental health are interlinked.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding antimicrobial-resistance terms?
o: ICMR-AMRSN – AMR surveillance network established in 2013
NDM-1 – New Delhi Metallo-β-lactamase causing resistance to β-lactams including carbapenems
Schedule H1 – red vertical line on antibiotic strips
Red Line Campaign – red vertical line on antibiotic strips
x: Schedule H1 requires select antibiotics to be sold only on prescription with a register kept; the red vertical line belongs to the Red Line Campaign.

s: As an AMR-control measure, in which of the following has India banned colistin?
x: The colistin ban applied to animal feed, not to human prescription medicines.

s: Which vaccine is used in India's free nationwide HPV vaccination programme for girls?
x: The programme uses single-dose quadrivalent Gardasil; the indigenous Cervavac is not yet WHO-approved for it.

s: In which year was the first National Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance (NAP-AMR 1.0) launched?
x: NAP-AMR 1.0 came in 2017; NAP-AMR 2.0 covers 2025–29.

s: What is the full form of NDM-1, linked to resistance to carbapenems?
x: NDM-1 is New Delhi Metallo-β-lactamase, giving resistance to β-lactams including carbapenems.

s: Which body recommended the HPV vaccine for India's free nationwide vaccination programme for girls?
x: The National Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation (NTAGI) recommended the HPV vaccine.

s: Which of the following States was among the only seven States with a State action plan under NAP-AMR 1.0?
x: Only seven States made State AMR plans: Kerala, MP, Delhi, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Sikkim and Punjab.

s: How many doses of Gardasil are given under India's free HPV vaccination programme for girls?
x: A single dose is given, with an optional second dose after 3-5 years.

s: Under the WHO 90-70-90 targets for cervical cancer by 2030, 90% of girls should be vaccinated against HPV by what age?
x: WHO aims for 90% of girls vaccinated by 15, 70% of women screened and 90% treated by 2030.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India has the highest MDR-TB burden in the world.
2. India is the largest consumer of antibiotics in animals.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: India has the highest MDR-TB burden but is the 4th largest consumer of animal antibiotics.

s: Antibiotic levels about 1,000 times the safe limit were reported in which river?
x: The Musi river at Hyderabad had antibiotic levels about 1,000 times safe limits.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's adolescent mental-health context?
o: About 20% of adolescents have diagnosable mental-health conditions
India has more than 800 million internet users
India has fewer than 10,000 psychiatrists for more than 1.4 billion people
Tele-MANAS is part of the recognised policy response
x: The National Mental Health Survey puts adolescents with diagnosable conditions at 7–10%, not 20%. The other statements are correct.

s: What is the fatality rate of Kyasanur Forest Disease?
x: Kyasanur Forest Disease has a fatality rate of 5–10%; there is no antiviral treatment, but a vaccine is available.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about scabies?
o: It is caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei.
WHO classifies it as a Neglected Tropical Disease.
Its itching is worse at night.
It is a contagious viral skin disease.
x: Scabies is a parasitic (mite-caused) skin disease, not a viral one; the other statements are correct.

s: Which of the following is NOT part of the policy response recognised for adolescent mental health in India?
o: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres
x: TKDL is a traditional-knowledge database, not a mental-health measure. NMHP, Tele-MANAS and Ayushman Bharat HWCs are part of the response.

s: A 29-year-old man died in Karnataka in January 2026 after contracting which disease?
x: The reported death in Karnataka was due to Kyasanur Forest Disease.

s: During which months does the Kyasanur Forest Disease season peak?
x: The KFD season starts in October–November and peaks in January–April; KFD has no human-to-human transmission.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the adolescent mental-health concern in India?
o: The issue was triggered by the deaths of three adolescent girls in Ghaziabad
The National Mental Health Survey indicated 7–10% of adolescents have diagnosable conditions
WHO guidelines of 2019 recommended excessive screen exposure
The National Mental Health Survey indicated 5–7% of school children have ADHD
x: The 2019 WHO guidelines warned against excessive screen exposure; they did not recommend it.

s: Which group of countries was cited as providing social-media regulation models in the discussion on adolescent mental health?
x: The cited models are from Australia, France and South Korea. The other options replace one of these countries with India or Japan, which are not part of the stated group.

s: What is the vector of Kyasanur Forest Disease (monkey fever)?
x: KFD is transmitted by the hard tick Haemaphysalis spinigera; the virus belongs to the genus Flavivirus (family Flaviviridae).

s:
Consider the following statements about Kyasanur Forest Disease:
1. It was first identified in 1957 in Karnataka.
2. Its fatality rate is 20–30%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: KFD was first identified in 1957 in Kyasanur Forest, Karnataka. Its fatality rate is 5–10%, so 2 is wrong.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Kyasanur Forest Disease?
o: It is a tick-borne viral haemorrhagic disease
A vaccine is available against it
A specific antiviral drug is available for it
Its virus belongs to the family Flaviviridae
x: There is no antiviral for KFD, although a vaccine is available.

s: How many new All India Institutes of Ayurveda were provided for in the AYUSH measures for 2026–27?
x: Three new All India Institutes of Ayurveda were provided for in 2026–27.

s: Which initiative announced in the 2026–27 Budget is an AI assistant for medicinal plant farmers?
x: Bharat-VISTAAR is the AI assistant announced for medicinal plant farmers. The National AYUSH Mission is a funding-related mission, the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library concerns traditional knowledge, and the WHO centre is located in Jamnagar.

s: Under the India–EU FTA, AYUSH wellness centres are envisaged across how many EU states?
x: Wellness centres are envisaged across 27 EU states, and AYUSH practitioners may practise there with Indian qualifications.

s: What is the AYUSH allocation in the Union Budget 2026–27?
x: AYUSH got ₹4,408 crore in 2026–27, up from ₹3,992 crore in 2025–26.

s: Which of the following systems is NOT part of AYUSH?
x: AYUSH covers Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy, not Allopathy.

s: Where is the WHO Global Traditional Medicine Centre, to be upgraded under the 2026-27 Budget, located?
x: The WHO Global Traditional Medicine Centre is at Jamnagar, Gujarat.

s: Which body regulates the Indian systems of medicine, along with the National Commission for Homoeopathy?
x: NCISM and the National Commission for Homoeopathy are the AYUSH regulators.

s: Which Indian database was recognised in the India-EU FTA to fight biopiracy?
x: The India-EU FTA recognises the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) against biopiracy.

s: PM VIKAS, the Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs, combines skilling with which of the following?
o: Loans up to ₹15 lakh for entrepreneurs
x: PM VIKAS (Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan) combines skilling with heritage promotion for six minorities. The others describe PM-SURAJ, NAMASTE and PMAY-G.

s: Which body runs the NAMASTE scheme, which replaced SRMS?
x: NAMASTE replaced SRMS and is run by NSKFDC (1997), not NSFDC (1989).

s: Which Ministry launched the PM-SURAJ portal, which provides loans up to ₹15 lakh, in 2024?
x: PM-SURAJ was launched in 2024 by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE).

s: What is the PMAY-G target for houses to be built by March 2029?
x: PMAY-G targets 4.95 crore houses by March 2029; 3.87 crore+ are sanctioned and 2.95 crore+ completed.

s: Which of the following corporations is correctly matched with the year it was set up?
x: NSFDC was set up on 8 February 1989; NBCFDC in 1992 and NSKFDC on 24 January 1997.

s: What is the full form of PM VIKAS of the Ministry of Minority Affairs?
o: Pradhan Mantri Vikas Karyakram for Alpsankhyak
x: PM VIKAS (Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan) combines skilling with heritage for six minorities.

s: Since when has PMAY-Gramin been in operation?
x: PMAY-G runs from 1 April 2016; target 4.95 crore houses by March 2029.

s: Which Ministry launched the Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana for senior citizens in 2021?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development
x: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (2021) is a MoSJE scheme.

s: How much was provided for Centres of Excellence for AI education, linked to the SOAR initiative?
x: ₹500 crore was provided for Centres of Excellence for AI education; the President attended the SOAR event.

s: Under the August 2024 benchmark linked to ULLAS, what literacy level is treated as 100% “fully literate”?
x: The August 2024 benchmark treats 95% literacy as 100% fully literate.

s: What does SANKALP stand for in the context of the skilling sector?
o: Social Knowledge and Assistance for Livelihood Promotion
Skill Acquisition and Knowledge Awareness for Livelihood Promotion
Skill Advancement and Knowledge Access for Labour Participation
Socioeconomic Knowledge Acquisition for Local Prosperity
x: SANKALP stands for Skill Acquisition and Knowledge Awareness for Livelihood Promotion. The other expansions alter the official wording of the programme's name.

s: Rajasthan made daily newspaper reading of at least how many minutes mandatory in government schools (January 2026)?
x: Rajasthan prescribed at least 10 minutes of daily newspaper reading in government schools.

s: Which State refused to join ULLAS and runs its own Akshar Anchal scheme?
x: Bihar did not join ULLAS and runs the Akshar Anchal scheme for Dalits, Mahadalits, minorities, EBCs and women aged 15–45.

s: Who launched the “Badhna Hai Toh Yahan Judna Hai” campaign at the AI Impact Summit on 22 February 2026?
x: Jayant Chaudhary launched the campaign on 22 February 2026 at the AI Impact Summit.

s: ULLAS targets non-literates aged 15 and above with literacy up to which level, followed by a test and certification?
x: ULLAS provides literacy up to Class 3 level for non-literates aged 15+, followed by a test and certification.

s: As per PLFS 2023–24 literacy data, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: Bihar males recorded 82.3%. Andhra Pradesh was 72.6%, Bihar overall 74.3% and Bihar females 66.1%.

s: Which of the following was NOT among the States and Union Territory declared fully literate under the ULLAS-related assessment?
x: Sikkim was not included among the places declared fully literate. The listed places were Himachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Goa, Tripura and Ladakh.

s: What is the full form of ULLAS?
o: Universal Literacy and Learning for All Students
Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society
Understanding Literacy and Learning Among Seniors
x: ULLAS stands for Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society, launched in 2022 by the Education Ministry.

s:
Consider the following statements about literacy as per PLFS 2023–24:
1. Andhra Pradesh has the lowest literacy rate, at 72.6%.
2. Bihar has the lowest literacy rate, at 74.3%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Andhra Pradesh is lowest at 72.6%; Bihar (74.3%) is second lowest, so 2 is wrong.

s: Which institution assists SANKALP, launched on 19 January 2018 under MSDE?
x: SANKALP is a World Bank-assisted centrally sponsored scheme of MSDE.

s: To which institutions does the ONGC–NSTFDC MoU of 5 January 2026 provide ₹28 crore CSR support?
x: ONGC and NSTFDC signed an MoU for ₹28 crore CSR support to Eklavya Model Residential Schools.

s: Through which platform does the 'Badhna Hai Toh Yahan Judna Hai' campaign promote digital skilling?
x: The campaign, launched by Jayant Chaudhary on 22 February 2026, promotes digital skilling via the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH).

s: By which year does ULLAS aim to achieve 100% literacy?
x: ULLAS, launched in 2022 by the Union Education Ministry, aims at 100% literacy by 2030 (NEP 2020, SDG-4).

s: With which body did MSDE launch the Swavalambini women entrepreneurship pilot in February 2025?
x: Swavalambini was launched by MSDE with NITI Aayog's WEP in 6 HEIs.

s: 'Yuva AI for All', a free course to reach about 1 crore citizens, came from a tie-up of the IndiaAI Mission with which company?
x: The Simplilearn-IndiaAI Mission MoU offers the free 'Yuva AI for All' course.

s:
The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) recently introduced a national standard to test and assess bomb disposal systems.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. The new standard is known as IS 19445:2025.
2. It will improve interoperability of equipment across agencies.
3. It was developed by TBRL, DRDO in collaboration with the 30th Central Scientific Research Institute, Russia. Select the answer using the code given below:
x: Statement 1 is correct: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) recently notified India's first dedicated national standard for bomb disposal systems, officially designated as IS 19445:2025. It establishes comprehensive guidelines for evaluating bomb disposal systems (like bomb blankets, baskets, and inhibitors) against blast loads and splinter effects. Statement 2 is correct: A primary objective of this standard is to bring uniformity in evaluation practices. By establishing a transparent and uniform basis for procurement, testing, and certification, it aims to significantly improve the reliability and Science and Technology PMF IAS S&T – 99 interoperability of equipment used across various security units (such as the Armed Forces, Central Armed Police Forces, and State Police). Statement 3 is incorrect: The standard was not developed in collaboration with a Russian institute. It was developed indigenously by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) at the request of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and the Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory (TBRL), DRDO. TBRL served as the convenor for the expert panel (under the Arms and Ammunition for Civilian Use Sectional Committee), working with Indian stakeholders such as the Bureau of Police Research and Development (BPR&D) to adapt global best practices to Indian threat scenarios and operational conditions.

s: Under the Vanajeevi Didi initiative for women forest guardians in Palamau Tiger Reserve, what incentive was provided initially?
x: The Vanajeevi Didi initiative provided an incentive of ₹3,000 per month initially for two months. The tempting alternative of ₹3,000 per month for six months is incorrect because the initial incentive period was only two months.

s: The Vanajeevi Didi initiative for women forest guardians was launched in which location?
x: Vanajeevi Didi was launched on 17 February 2026 in the Garu Range of Palamau Tiger Reserve, Jharkhand, under the PTR South Division. Latehar is associated with Palamau Tiger Reserve, while the other options do not identify the launch location.

s: Under which Act does the Bureau of Indian Standards currently function?
x: The current law is the BIS Act, 2016; 1986 is cited as the year of establishment, not the current Act.

s: On which date did Womaniya on GeM complete seven years?
x: Womaniya on GeM, launched on 14 January 2019, completed seven years on 14 January 2026.

s:
Assertion (A): Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat aims to achieve a child-marriage-free India by 2030.
Reason (R): The programme targets a 10% reduction in child-marriage prevalence by 2030.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Assertion A is true: the target is to achieve a child-marriage-free India by 2030. Reason R is false because the target to reduce prevalence by 10% is set for 2026, not 2030.

s: When was SANKALP launched?
x: SANKALP was launched on 19 January 2018.

s: The Public Accounts Committee associated with scrutiny of SANKALP was established in which year?
x: The Public Accounts Committee was established in 1921. The other years refer to establishment dates of organisations or institutions in the related schemes and social-sector context.

s: What does the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana mainly provide?
o: Nutrition supplements for children under six
Wage-loss compensation for pregnant and lactating women
Free HPV vaccination for adolescent girls
x: PMMVY provides wage-loss compensation for pregnant and lactating women.

s: Till when has the Union Cabinet extended the Atal Pension Yojana?
x: The Cabinet extended the Atal Pension Yojana till FY 2030–31; it then had 8.66 crore subscribers.

s: When was the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana launched under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao?
x: The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on 22 January 2015 under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.

s: The SHINE Scheme of the Bureau of Indian Standards is intended to achieve which of the following?
o: Place women at the centre of the quality ecosystem through NGOs and SHGs
Provide pension support to senior citizens through local bodies
Promote artificial intelligence education through Centres of Excellence
Coordinate CSR partnerships for women and children
x: SHINE stands for Standards Help Inform & Nurture Empowered Women and places women at the centre of the quality ecosystem through NGOs and SHGs. The other options refer to unrelated social-sector initiatives.

s: What is the eligible joining age under the Atal Pension Yojana?
x: Subscribers can join the Atal Pension Yojana between 18 and 40 years of age.

s: As per NFHS-5, what share of women aged 20–24 had married before 18?
x: NFHS-5 reported that 23% of women aged 20–24 had married before attaining 18.

s: In which year was the Sarada Act against child marriage passed?
x: The Sarada Act dates to 1929. The Age of Consent Act was 1891, and the prescribed ages were raised in 1948 and 1978.

s: The Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana completed how many years on 1 January 2026?
x: PMMVY, launched on 1 January 2017, completed nine years on 1 January 2026.

s: The Pankhudi portal, launched on 8 January 2026, is an initiative of which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
x: The Ministry of Women and Child Development launched the Pankhudi portal on 8 January 2026.

s: Pankhudi portal, launched on 8 January 2026 by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, is primarily associated with which of the following?
o: Direct transfer of pensions to elderly citizens
Coordination of CSR and partnerships for women and children
Monitoring of agricultural subsidies for farmers
x: Pankhudi is a CSR and partnership coordination portal for women and children, launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development. The other options describe unrelated social-sector activities and are not the portal’s stated purpose.

s: Between which stations does the first Vande Bharat Sleeper train, flagged off on 17 January 2026, run?
x: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper runs Howrah – Kamakhya (Guwahati); it was flagged off from Malda Town.

s: Where is the University of Southampton campus, the first foreign university campus in India under the UGC (2023) regulations?
x: The University of Southampton (UK) campus at Gurugram, Haryana was inaugurated on 15 July 2025.

s: How many Letters of Intent for foreign university campuses were reported to Parliament in December 2025?
x: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan reported 13 Letters of Intent on 9 December 2025.

s: Which body administers the Atal Pension Yojana?
x: APY, under the Department of Financial Services, is administered by PFRDA.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Atal Pension Yojana:
1. It gives a monthly pension of ₹1,000–5,000 after age 60.
2. Income tax payers are eligible to join it.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: APY gives ₹1,000–5,000 a month after 60. Income tax payers and NPS subscribers are not eligible, so 2 is wrong.

s: Below what age can a Sukanya Samriddhi account be opened for a girl?
x: Sukanya Samriddhi is for girls below 10; the account matures in 21 years.

s: With which body has Womaniya on GeM signed an MoU?
x: Womaniya on GeM has an MoU with the Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP).

s: The Bureau of Indian Standards functions under which Ministry?
o: Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
x: BIS, headquartered in New Delhi, is under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.

s: In SHINE, the BIS scheme 'Standards Help Inform & Nurture Empowered ...', what is the last word?
x: SHINE = Standards Help Inform & Nurture Empowered Women; it places women at the centre of the quality ecosystem through NGOs and SHGs.

s: Where is the headquarters of the Bureau of Indian Standards?
x: BIS, the national standards body under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, has its headquarters in New Delhi.

s: In which year was the Bureau of Indian Standards established?
x: BIS was set up in 1986 as the successor of ISI (1947); it now works under the BIS Act, 2016.

s: What was the earlier name of the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana?
o: Rajiv Gandhi Scheme for Empowerment of Adolescent Girls
x: PMMVY, the maternity benefit scheme of the Ministry of WCD, was earlier the Indira Gandhi Matritva Sahyog Yojana.

s: For which of the following is IS 19445:2025 the first national standard of BIS?
x: IS 19445:2025 is BIS's first national standard for bomb disposal systems.

s: From which station did PM Modi flag off the first Vande Bharat Sleeper train on 17 January 2026?
x: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper (Howrah - Kamakhya) was flagged off from Malda Town, West Bengal.

s: In which year was the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act enacted?
x: The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act came in 2006; the Sarada Act was of 1929.

s: After how many years does a Sukanya Samriddhi account mature?
x: Deposits are made for 15 years and the account matures in 21 years.

s: In which district of Jharkhand is the Palamau Tiger Reserve, where Vanajeevi Didi was launched?
x: Palamau Tiger Reserve (est. 1973) is in Latehar district.

s: Under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural Livelihoods Mission, the number of Lakhpati Didis—women earning more than ₹1 lakh annually—has crossed which milestone?
x: The number of Lakhpati Didis under DAY-NRLM has crossed 2 crore. The tempting figure of 1 crore is incorrect because the reported milestone is more than twice that number.
